finding: head.status=="review" is not a branch main.md's Step-0b resume dispatcher recognizes, and it freezes the ENTIRE idle-chain (BOUNDED-1, SLS, RLC, and QA-Drain itself), not just deprioritizes QA-Drain.
evidence: docs/agents/dev-team/flow/main.md lines 435-524 (Step-0b resume) branch exhaustively on head.status == "in_progress" (WF-1/WF-2/spawn) and head.status == "idle"|"done"|missing|v1 (fall through to BOUNDED-1). grep -n '"review"' main.md returns zero matches — no third branch exists for status=="review".

BOUNDED-1 (line 524), the Ready-Lane Consumer, and Review-Lane QA-Drain (line ~679: 'Runs immediately after the Ready-Lane Consumer block above, still inside the same head-idle fall-through') are ALL nested inside the same head.status==idle fallthrough. When head is pinned at 'review', none of the four lanes fire — QA-Drain, the exact mechanism built to sweep stranded review[] rows, cannot run precisely when a row IS parked at head with status=review.

The write pattern `.head.status = "review"` on in_progress->review transitions is an established, repo-wide convention (12+ scripts under scripts/*-to-review.jq follow it, e.g. scripts/dev-mcp-server-task-devteam-idle-chain-1-schema-utilities-to-review.jq committed this tick, c134f0369) -- so this is not a one-off, it is the normal shape every dev-* completion produces.

grep of docs/agents/qa/flow/main.md for head.status found exactly one match, a post-handling RESET (not a trigger condition) -- no evidence QA has an independent poll/cron path that would notice a head pinned at review and self-dispatch.

Live symptom consistent with this mechanism: task_board.review[] grew from 94 rows (next_agent=qa subset, observed ~05:07Z this session) to 134 rows (98 next_agent=qa) by 07:00Z, oldest 6+ days -- growth continued right through this session's own dev-team ticks.

Directly relevant to TASK-DEVTEAM-IDLE-CHAIN-2-MAIN-FLOW (owner: dev-team, depends: [TASK-DEVTEAM-IDLE-CHAIN-1-SCHEMA-UTILITIES], not yet dispatched -- T1 landed in REVIEW this tick, commit 589224138/c134f0369/b3e98ee9b) which is scoped to replace this fixed-priority chain with the architect-brief aged-round-robin (2026-07-25-devteam-idle-chain-rotation-durable-inbox.md). Whoever implements T2 needs this exact head-status gap in scope, not just the priority-ordering fix -- a rotation among 5 consumers gated behind the SAME head.status==idle precondition inherits the identical freeze.
not_yet_determined: Whether any other path (agent-to-agent direct handoff at the moment a developer flips a row to review, a QA-side cron, or a router-side sweep) is SUPPOSED to notice head==review and dispatch qa directly -- I found no such path in main.md or qa/flow/main.md, but have not exhaustively read every dev-*/flow/*.md to rule out a per-agent direct-spawn-QA step.
recommendation: PO/architect judgement call for TASK-DEVTEAM-IDLE-CHAIN-2-MAIN-FLOW's scope: either (a) the aged round-robin gate condition must be broadened from head.status==idle to include head.status==review (so a parked review row doesn't block the other 4 consumers), or (b) developer flows must directly spawn qa at the moment they flip a row to review (closing the gap without touching head-status semantics), or (c) both.
